patch.value: Jira->pm: status by NAME first, falling back to statusCategory bucket (new/indeterminate/done) so custom workflows resolve; --map status=/statuscategory= pins. issuetype->pm type heuristic (Bug/Story=Feature/Epic=Feature/Task) with --map type=/issuetype= override. assignee->'assignee:<name>' tag (no dedicated pm field; --map assignee=skip opts out; #97 means no custom-field setter). priority via existing name heuristic. Export reverse maps priority+issuetype only under --rich to keep the historical 'always Task, no priority' shape as default.
